description: Behavior-preservation (golden-master) gate. Tier-2 (GPU): recovered per-frame pose vs fem.jts within tolerance; projected silhouette vs Labels within pixel threshold. Tolerance finalized from the one-time Qt5/GPU capture (fem_oracle.jtak). RE-BASELINED 2026-08-12 (plan 008 U4, Finding 1/12): the one live kernel bug (distance-map grid index, src/compute/distance_map_metric.cu:27) is fixed and the Tier-2 oracle re-run is recorded as the new reference — expected_pose_per_frame now holds the POST-FIX recovered poses; the fem.jts golden seeds live in start_pose_per_frame; the pre-fix poses and the per-axis delta are recorded in rebaseline_2026-08-12.

compare_reference.tier1: CI headless CPU: DirectOptimizer converges on analytic cost (test/unit/test_direct_optimizer.cpp)
compare_reference.tier2: GPU (robust, appearance-based): project the implant (DRR) at the final optimized pose and compare the rendered silhouette to Labels/fem/ within a pixel-diff / IoU threshold. Pose-vs-fem.jts is informational only, because DIRECT numeric convergence is noisy.

settings.budget_note: Production cumulative caps from src/services/optimizer_settings.cpp defaults + Optimize(): trunk 20000, +2 branches 5000 each, +leaf 5000. The Tier-2 oracle run was reduced to a flat 3000 for run time and is NOT the production budget shape.

golden_units: fem.jts (3 frames, JT_EULER_312: x_tran,y_tran,z_tran,z_rot,x_rot,y_rot) — the optimizer SEED poses and the pose-gap reference, recorded in start_pose_per_frame. Since the 2026-08-12 re-baseline, expected_pose_per_frame holds the POST-FIX RECOVERED poses (the engine's actual optima on the fixed kernel), not fem.jts.

captured_baseline.notes: Direct comparative output of the Qt5/GPU pipeline on Kneel_1 (pre-fix kernel, production-shaped run). Historical reference only since the 2026-08-12 re-baseline (rebaseline_2026-08-12 below): its frame-1 z gap (6.31 mm) was the plan's ORIGINAL direction-prediction basis, but it was measured on a DIFFERENT pipeline than the Tier-2 oracle — the oracle's own pre-fix frame-1 z gap was 1.19 mm (see the rebaseline verdict).

rebaseline_2026-08-12.event: The ONE re-baseline (plan 008 U4, Findings 1/12): the distance-map kernel index fix (src/compute/distance_map_metric.cu:27 — blockIdx.y + gridDim.x -> blockIdx.y * gridDim.x) + a Tier-2 oracle re-run, SINGLE-VARIABLE (Canny pinned 3/0/150; dilation 6; backface culling OFF; flat budget 3000; search range (12,12,15,15,15,15) — run_config unchanged; nothing else bundled). Both the pre-fix and post-fix oracle runs below were executed on THIS pipeline (test/oracle/oracle_test.cpp on the RTX 3090), so the delta is a same-pipeline comparison. Deterministic: the pre-fix frame-0 numbers reproduce the originally recorded measured block bit-for-bit (IoU 0.993627, L1 21675).
rebaseline_2026-08-12.direction_claim: Finding 12 / angle 02 pre-registration: post-fix recovered z moves TOWARD fem.jts (-1027.713) and the 6.31 mm frame-1 gap shrinks materially.
rebaseline_2026-08-12.verdict: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED on the same-pipeline data, REFUTED as a material move: (a) the only frame the fix moved was frame 0 — recovered z moved toward fem.jts by 0.014 mm (|z gap| 0.9054 -> 0.8916 mm), direction CONFIRMED, magnitude negligible; (b) frames 1 and 2 recovered bit-identically pre/post (DIRECT's discrete partition did not move) — no gap shrink; (c) the 6.31 mm frame-1 gap was the Qt5 fem_oracle.jtak capture's number (a DIFFERENT pipeline, captured_baseline above); THIS oracle's frame-1 z gap was already 1.19 mm pre-fix, so 'shrinks materially' is refuted as a claim about this pipeline. Net: the fix's recovered-pose impact is tiny (frame-0 z +0.014 mm; IoU 0.993627 -> 0.993779; per-px L1 0.020671 -> 0.020185), far inside the 15 mm z informational band — the trustworthy baseline is the post-fix reference above, and later gates cite these numbers.

adversarial_probe.sweep: 14 poses over DIRECT_DILATION: ±200 mm off-axis (x/y/z), behind camera (z = +200/+500), 90/180-degree rotations about each axis
adversarial_probe.result: all 14 evals FINITE and cudaGetLastError() == cudaSuccess after each, pre-fix and post-fix identically (the sticky-error trap at render_engine.cu:713 stays closed; it is NOT deleted here — that is the perf plan's Cut 1)
adversarial_probe.direct_mahfouz_at_empty_silhouette: -nan (isfinite=0) with clean cudaGetLastError — the Bug-6 0/0 via the always-true pointer guard at implant_mahfouz_metric.cu:324/:446, RECORDED only (not asserted); the value guards are the deferred hygiene pass

observed_max_gap_vs_golden.note: Post-fix Tier-2 oracle maxima (2026-08-12, per-frame |gap| vs fem.jts across the 3 Kneel_1 frames). The pre-re-baseline values (x 0.16 / y 0.08 / z 6.31 / z_rot 0.44 / x_rot 0.38 / y_rot 0.10) were the Qt5 fem_oracle.jtak capture's — see rebaseline_2026-08-12.verdict.

measured.note: POST-FIX reference (2026-08-12 re-baseline, plan 008 U4) measured via test/oracle/oracle_test.cpp on the RTX 3090. The legacy singular keys below keep frame 0 for backward readability; the per-frame rows are the reference every later gate cites.
measured.run_config: DIRECT_DILATION; budget 3000 (reduced from cumulative 20k/25k/30k/35k for run time); search range (12,12,15,15,15,15) around fem.jts start pose; Canny 3/0/150; dilation 6; backface culling OFF (matches label generator Study2Grid); distance-map kernel index FIXED at src/compute/distance_map_metric.cu:27 (plan 008 U4 — the one re-baseline, single-variable)
measured.frame_label_mapping: 1024/2806.tif <-> Labels/fem/AT_K1_V1_0160_label_fem.tif; 1024/2807.tif <-> Labels/fem/AT_K1_V1_0170_label_fem.tif; 1024/2808.tif <-> Labels/fem/AT_K1_V1_0180_label_fem.tif (resolved empirically per frame: start-pose render IoU == 1.0; the binary label TIFFs use a bottom-left y-origin, so the oracle vertically flips the label)

tolerances.notes: The HARD Tier-2 gate is the rendered-silhouette-vs-Labels IoU (>0.85, a healthy margin below the observed 0.9938-0.9946); per-px L1 and pose-vs-fem.jts are informational, because DIRECT numeric convergence is noisy. The frame<->label correspondence is pinned empirically by start-pose IoU == 1.0 per frame. Post-fix measurements recorded on the RTX 3090 (2026-08-12 re-baseline); other GPU hardware may vary slightly. The distance-map index fix moved only frame 0's recovery (z +0.014 mm toward fem.jts; frames 1/2 bit-identical) — see rebaseline_2026-08-12 for the full delta record.
